Anita: heads up — noticed a memory growth regression on the long-context perf harness after landing the continuous-batching merge change yesterday. can repro locally with 32k context workloads.
Matt K: ugh. which change specifically? the head-of-line merge logic?
Anita: yeah the new merge path where we combine short and long batches. allocation profile shows KV entries not being reclaimed and fragments piling up.
Ryan S: do you have a flame/alloc map?
Anita: pasted run from perf-bot below. key bits: 70% of heap growth attributed to `kv_slot` objects, many small allocations per merge.
perf-bot: ```
# perf summary (cont-batch-merge experiment)
heap delta: +1.2GB over 10m
top alloc sites:
  34% kv_slot::alloc_fragment()
  18% kv_fragment::append()
  12% batch_merge::create_temp_kv()
  10% arena::alloc()
```
Olga: any sign of increased fragmentation vs simple batching?
Anita: yes — the fragmentation metric (free fragments / total fragments) jumped from ~3% to ~22% under sustained long contexts. evictions aren't triggering because residency counters are being reset when merged batches reuse slots incorrectly.
Matt K: that sounds like a bug where merge drops the eviction metadata. can you grep for `residency` touches in the merge path?
Anita: already did. `merge_batches()` currently does `kv->push(frags)` without copying the residency_score field; we pass pointers so the source's metadata can be clobbered.
Ryan S: so when a head-of-line blocked long request gets merged with many short requests, we end up with inconsistent slot ownership. That explains reuse anomalies.
Olga: repro script? can we add an invariant check in debug builds: ensure `residency_score >= 0 && last_touch_ts != 0` after merges?
Anita: plan: add debug assertions + a small fix to clone residency metadata during merge. Also add an eviction soft-limit: if fragmentation > 15% trigger eager reclaim.
Matt K: good. any perf downside cloning metadata? should be negligible compared to the memory churn we're saving.
Ryan S: can we also tweak the merge heuristic to avoid merging long-context leader batches unless lane occupancy < 0.3? fewer risky merges = fewer breakages.
Anita: will experiment. quick patch with assertions and metadata clone in a PR now. linking run logs: https://perf.corp/runs/1876543200
perf-bot: regression alert attached: cont-batch-merge v2 -> +18% mem on 32k long-context tests (detected 2027-11-02T09:12:03Z)
Matt K: thanks. once PR is up assign to me for review — we should also add a micro-benchmark that simulates long-tail KV occupancy.
Anita: will add micro-bench and a minimal unit test that forces merge with non-zero residency. aim to roll to canary after tests pass.
Olga: also add a tracing tag so we can correlate head-of-line merges with subsequent evictions on the console. that will help SRE debug any future flares.
Ryan S: FYI, I ran a quick patch locally that clones residency and memory stopped growing in 15m run. no perf regression in token throughput.
Anita: excellent. PR in 5m. thanks all :thumbsup:
